shows: faction card + abilities with charge counts (post-murder)
character_tab.killer_extra: Cover story pinned at top, marked YOUR STORY — the account you give if pressed or synced. Includes which herring it points at.
character_tab.note: Motive and fear are always visible to the player. People play their character better when the phone keeps reminding them what they're hiding.

knowledge_tab.structure: A hand of fact cards. Each card = one discrete thing this player knows.
card_sources: facts shared by other players (received cards)
ability results (sync pulls, forensics, killer check, dig-dirt)
card_fields: source (what you saw / clue scan / told by {name})
knowledge_tab.why_cards: Cards make knowledge discrete, tradeable, and trackable. A player scanning their hand mid-conversation is diegetic — everyone is on their phones at parties.

share_mechanic.flow: Open a fact card → SHARE → scan the other player's badge (or pick from recent scans) → card appears in their knowledge tab, tagged 'told by {name}'.
rules: Sharing is voluntary and unverified — you can tell someone anything out loud; sharing the card is vouching for it.
Shared cards are copies. You never lose your own.
Killers CAN share their cover-story facts. The card reads as any other testimony. Sync results and forensics results are marked VERIFIED and cannot be forged — but CAN be withheld.
No free-text cards. Players can write private notes, but only real fact cards can be shared. Same reasoning as ghost canned messages: no fabrication channel.
feeds_engine: Info-flow graph: who has told what to whom, when — on top of the badge graph's who-met-whom.

Contradiction detection upgrades from 'two players HOLD conflicting facts' to 'X was TOLD conflicting facts by Y and Z' — the engine can now route the person holding both versions directly at the liar.
Circulation stats: facts that have never been shared get clue_linked prompts pointed at their holder ('You're sitting on something nobody has heard').
Endgame stats screen: most-traded fact, best-traveled lie, the fact that never left one phone.

player_phone.prompts_tab: Current prompt from the engine, plus the last two. Prompts expire visibly — a nudge you ignored for ten minutes stops being displayed as actionable.
player_phone.map_tab: Floor plan with the west wing greyed out. Mirrors the main screen's map state: unsearched vs found pins. Clue contents live on the main screen once scanned — your phone holds your private layer (knowledge cards, notes), the board holds the public one.
player_phone.notes_tab: Free-text private scratchpad. Never shared, never read by the engine.

tracking_summary.badge_graph: who met whom, when, where — from name-tag QR scans (prompts.json)
tracking_summary.info_flow_graph: who told what to whom, when — from the share mechanic (this file)
tracking_summary.clue_graph: who scanned which physical clue, when — from clue QR scans
tracking_summary.ability_log: every sync, forensic, check, tamper, share — timestamped, for the engine and the endgame stats
tracking_summary.consumed_by: prompt engine priority rules (prompts.json), facilitator consoles (live view of all four), endgame stats screen
